statement: A fake credential in a public test is still a credential-shaped finding: every secret scanner that reads the source matches the prefix joined to a value, not whether the value is real. Two input-binding test files carried fake GitLab tokens as literals and were flagged. Rules: build any credential-shaped fixture at runtime from its halves so the source never holds the joined shape; keep every withheld or redacted assertion on the same runtime string, so the test proves exactly what it proved before; and find the literals with the scanner's own pattern across the file, not from a line list, because one file held two distinct fake tokens where the brief anticipated one.
